nodes.label: Five Binance-attributed compromised XRPL source wallets
XRP ETF flow and AUM aggregators

edges.claim: TRM reports 233.46M XRP drained from five Binance-attributed XRPL wallets; Bitquery independently reports approximately 233.5M XRP at the same receiver and no outgoing transaction through 03:54 UTC. Later disposition is unknown.

CoinDesk reports Binance 14 appears in Binance's October 1 PoR wallet set and that approximately 204,500 ETH was drained, implying ETH customer backing near 94% until replenishment. This is an Ethereum-specific finding, not evidence about the five XRPL source wallets or XRP reserve ratio.

The 02:23 UTC Binance Support update said deposits and withdrawals were temporarily suspended; a verified Binance News post later reported deposits normal and withdrawals paused, but its exact publication time and per-network scope were not exposed.
Investing.com displayed OKX XRP/USD at $1.2256, -5.41% over 24 hours at 03:41:35 UTC. The quote is stale by the 07:09 UTC capture and is not a consolidated spot price.

Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M October 29 flow across five spot funds; TheXRPInvestor reports 12 products but categories totaling 11 and includes spot, derivatives and index products. These figures are not directly comparable.

Main still has scheduled/workflow-run triggers, contents:write and git commit/push. PR #1365 replaces these with read-only artifacts; exact-head core CI passed 342 tests plus 8 subtests and the fail-closed gate passed. PR remains draft/unmerged.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 233.46M XRP theft creates a potential future supply overhang if the attacker moves or sells it.
support: TRM and Bitquery report approximately 233.5M XRP moved to the same receiver.
Bitquery observed no outgoing transaction through 03:54 UTC.
counter: No sale or exchange deposit was confirmed by that cutoff.
The receiver's later disposition is unknown.
On-chain transfer alone does not establish sell intent.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Binance customer XRP reserve coverage may have been impaired if one of the five stolen source wallets was included in the October 1 XRP proof-of-reserves wallet set.
support: Five Binance-attributed XRPL wallets lost 233.46M native XRP.
October 1 secondary reporting placed Binance XRP reserve ratio near 100.77%.
counter: The five source wallet addresses and XRP-BF2 reserve address have not been cross-referenced.
CoinDesk's Binance 14 reserve-wallet finding concerns Ethereum, not XRPL.
Binance says it will cover all losses; replenishment not yet independently measured.

competing_hypotheses.claim: Reported positive October 29 spot ETF flows may coexist with falling XRP spot prices because ETF demand is not the only marginal price-setting flow.
support: Alpha Finance reports +$8.4M across five spot funds for October 29.
OKX venue-specific snapshot at 03:41 UTC showed XRP down 5.41% over 24 hours.
counter: TheXRPInvestor mixes spot, derivative and index products and has a product-count mismatch.
The market quote is stale and venue-specific; no synchronized global spot panel.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The scheduled cross-analysis workflow continues to mutate main hourly until a read-only replacement is approved and merged.
support: Seven Cross-analysis refresh commits were observed from 01:00 through 06:52 UTC.
Main workflow still has contents: write, persisted checkout credentials, git add/commit/push.
counter: A fresh-main replacement PR #1365 has exact-head CI and fail-closed gate passing.
The replacement is still draft and unmerged.

source_independence.binance_official_updates: Same issuer; support-page and verified News status snapshots conflict and have unequal timestamp precision.
source_independence.trm_vs_bitquery: Separate analytics providers inspecting the same public XRPL transactions; independent methods, not independent underlying transactions.
source_independence.coindesk_por: Secondary analysis of Binance's October 1 PoR wallet set; the Binance 14 example is Ethereum-specific.
source_independence.investing_okx: Venue-specific OKX data surfaced through Investing.com; stale at capture and not a consolidated multi-venue quote.
source_independence.etf_aggregators: Alpha Finance and TheXRPInvestor have different product universes; TheXRPInvestor count/categories are internally inconsistent.
